Title: Open the Analytics reports library from the left nav
Preconditions: Logged in as org admin on the trial tenant.
Steps: 1. From any page click 'Analytics' in the left nav. | 2. If a report opens instead of the list click the 'Analytics' breadcrumb heading.
Expected Result: URL is /crm/sales/analytics; the reports list is shown with columns Name, Created by, Created date, Last Modified by, Last Modified date.
Notes: Landing may redirect to the last viewed report (non-deterministic, Open question 5); assert only that Analytics loads.

Title: Seeded Curated reports are listed
Preconditions: Logged in as org admin; reports library open.
Steps: 1. Open the Analytics library. | 2. Select the 'Curated' filter in the sidebar. | 3. Review the list.
Expected Result: 7 Curated seeded reports are listed (including 'Sales Dashboard').
Notes: Count observed in explore; may differ on other tenants.

Title: Create a report from a Gallery template widget
Preconditions: Logged in as org admin; full-run mode. Report will be named with ZZ prefix and trashed in cleanup.
Steps: 1. In Analytics click 'New Report'. | 2. In ADD WIDGETS click 'Gallery'. | 3. Choose 'Deals' in the entity dropdown on the Templates tab. | 4. Drag 'TOTAL Deals grouped by Sales owner' onto the canvas. | 5. Replace the report name 'Untitled Report' with 'ZZ Analytics QA 001'. | 6. Click 'Save'.
Expected Result: Toast 'TOTAL Deals grouped by Sales owner added successfully!' appears; after Save the report opens in view mode at /analytics/reports/<id>/page/1 with Export, Edit and a star; the chart shows data grouped by Sales owner.
Notes: Record entity in created-entities.json. Cleanup via TC-analytics-010.

Title: View Report Details dialog
Preconditions: A run-created ZZ report is open in view mode.
Steps: 1. Click the chevron icon next to the report name. | 2. Verify menu options. | 3. Click 'Report Details'. | 4. Click 'Cancel'.
Expected Result: Menu shows Report Details, Clone Report, Move to trash. Dialog shows Report Title, Report Description, Created by, Created date, Last Modified by, Last Modified date with Cancel and Done buttons. Cancel closes the dialog.

Title: Mark a run-created report as favorite
Preconditions: A run-created ZZ report is open in view mode.
Steps: 1. Click the star beside the report name. | 2. Open the Analytics library and select the 'Favorites' filter.
Expected Result: Star turns filled/orange. The report is expected to appear under Favorites.
Notes: Favorites listing is an unconfirmed assumption (Open question 4); star state is confirmed.

Title: Open curated Sales Dashboard
Steps: 1. In Analytics click the hamburger 'menu'. | 2. Click 'Sales Dashboard'.
Expected Result: Report opens at /analytics/reports/<id>/page/1 with a 'Curated' badge and 6 widgets: Contacts created over time, Contacts by owner, Open pipeline, Deals closed over time, Stage-wise forecast, Quota vs achievement ('No data!').
Notes: Read only. Do not edit or trash.

Title: Curated report widget options menu
Steps: 1. Open the options of any widget. | 2. Observe the menu items without selecting an export.
Expected Result: Menu shows Filters Applied, Export to Email and Download.

Title: Browse Analytics Settings and Schedules tab

Expected Result: Opens /analytics/settings/schedules showing 'You haven't configured any schedules.'

Title: Save a valid recurring schedule for the logged-in user (non-Monthly)
Flow / Source: schedule-report-validation; Edge case: valid schedule, self recipient, non-Monthly
Preconditions: A run-created ZZ report is open; full-run mode.
Steps: 1. Click 'Export' then 'Schedule report'. | 2. Click 'New Schedule'. | 3. Set Schedule name 'ZZ Schedule QA'. | 4. Change 'Send Report' from Monthly to Weekly or Daily. | 5. Expected Result: Schedule saves and is listed under 'Schedules - Report'. After cleanup it is deleted or disabled.
